m0-context.title: Load baseline context
m0-context.imperative: Read your inherited global doctrine (this skill's references/global-crew.md and references/global-everyone.md), then the project deltas if present: docs/agents/CREW_CONTEXT.md, docs/agents/GLOSSARY.md, plus the handoff and the relevant packet. Verify the handoff is complete (task, intent, scope, exclusions, required evidence, test mode, stop conditions); if incomplete, block and return. Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: crew context + glossary + handoff loaded; handoff complete

m1.title: <implementation step>
m1.imperative: <make the minimal change for this step>. Attest any check:null precondition BEFORE start — the engine refuses `start <id>` while a precondition is unmet, so the order is attest-precondition -> start (the refusal is non-destructive; just attest, then retry). TDD when the test mode requires it, red -> green -> refactor: encode the RED step as a check:null postcondition (manual attest of 'new test written and observed failing') — NOT a command check, because a command check would run the by-design-failing test and block the gate; keep the GREEN step as the command check. For a test-after/inspection run, collapse to the single green/observable postcondition (c2).

postconditions.statement: TDD red (when the test mode requires it): new test written and observed failing — manual attest; check MUST be null so the engine does not run the by-design-failing test
<observable behavior>; tests pass (TDD green — or the sole postcondition for a test-after/inspection run)
